ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "ADVANCED REHEARSAL TECHNIQUES AND ERROR DETECTION FOR WIND BAND." This upper level rehearsal techniques elective course offering is meant for any junior/senior or graduate student who desires more ‘hands on’ experience with rehearsing the wind band. While conducting gesture will be addressed, the focus of the class will be on rehearsal pacing, articulate delivery, engaging students in the ensemble, and hearing errors in an effort to make the ensemble sound better and be more musical.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
